There's a door in your hallway that wasn't there yesterday.
Same wall. Same pictures. But now, there's a door.

text: Your family walks right past it, like it's always been there.

That night, you hear knocking. From the other side.

text: Wait. If nobody is in there, who is knocking?
You see, every time it knocks, the sound gets closer to the handle.

So you open it. Just a little.
Inside is your hallway. Exactly the same.

text: And at the end of it... is you. Staring back.
